subject: E-Commerce
title: Free Shipping Threshold Magic
description: A fast breakdown of Free Shipping Threshold Magic for builders.

hook.text: 'Free shipping on orders over $35.' So you add a $7 item you don't need to avoid paying $5 shipping. Brilliant.

buildup.text: Free shipping thresholds increase average order value by 30%. Customers add items to 'save' on shipping.

discovery.text: The threshold is calculated to be just above the average order value. It's engineered to push you slightly higher.

twist.text: You spend $7 to save $5 in shipping and feel smart about it. The math loses but the psychology wins.

climax.text: Free shipping thresholds are one of the most profitable tricks in e-commerce. The cost is subsidized by upsells.

punchline.text: Spend $7 to save $5 shipping and feel clever. The threshold is a profit machine.

quiz.question: Why is the free shipping threshold set just above the average order value?
options: To push customers into adding extra items they don't need
